name: H-E-B San Marcos RSC - San Marcos TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck gate at the north entrance off the Hunter Rd / private access road; wide paved checkpoint apron with painted lane markings splitting around the booth.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Distinct red-roofed booth, ~1-2 vehicle footprint, set between the truck lanes at the entrance apron (z20/z21 imagery). A separate small kiosk-like structure also visible in an adjacent lane.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron with multiple painted lanes and unused paved width on either side of the booth; room to add an express bypass.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound from lane markings around the booth; resolution makes exact count uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks observed on multiple distinct building faces (NE face, SE/inner-courtyard faces) consistent with separate shipping and receiving operations of a large RSC.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large multi-section RSC; dozens of dock doors with trailers backed in across the NE face, SE face and interior courtyard faces - banded 50+; door count of ~110 is an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive marked trailer drop yard on the SW of the property plus a second trailer parking area on the NE; many trailers parked without tractors.
fieldNotes.railServed: A Union Pacific mainline runs parallel to the SE property line but no spur enters the site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial corridor in San Marcos with adjacent apartments, retail strip and other warehouses; judged Urban given dense surrounding development.
